checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same man, short grey hair, recognisable features
must.why: Face, hair and expression closely match; slight skin smoothing and slightly different face shape.
Navy blazer with white open-collar shirt.

must.item: Harsh lighting softened, realistic skin texture kept
must.why: Soft even light, skin texture and stubble retained.
Clean edges and natural look; minor perfection of the lapel/collar but no obvious artifacts.

faults.what: Face slightly re-rendered (a bit more defined, subtly different from the original), but still clearly the same man.
Shirt collar is unbuttoned and a bit casual with no tie; the user did not ask for any specific style.

summary: The output is a clean, professional headshot of the same man in a navy blazer and white shirt on a grey studio background, with only slight face re-rendering.
